setting.name: Empty Recycle Bin
setting.casual_explanation: This permanently empties the Recycle Bin across drives so deleted files stop taking up disk space.
setting.why_people_change_it: People run it when they want to reclaim storage or remove deleted files permanently.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: It reclaims space, but it permanently removes files that were still recoverable from the Recycle Bin. This record captures the shipped app behavior without yet promoting the card into the research-provider surface.
setting.professional_notes: The live app models this card as a command tweak that detects by counting Recycle Bin items through a PowerShell Shell.Application query and applies by running Clear-RecycleBin -Force. Repo cleanup docs and tweak provenance both map the tweak id to that exact action. The record stays review-required until command-backed cleanup actions are promoted through the research-provider path.

decision.why: The live recycle-bin cleanup behavior is clear and repo-backed, but it still ships only from the first-party provider and has no rollback.
blocking_issues: The card has not yet been promoted into the research-provider surface.
This is a one-shot destructive cleanup action without rollback.
decision.promotion_disposition_reason: Closed as rejected for research-provider promotion because the live action is one-shot, destructive, high-risk, reboot-sensitive, or lacks a rollback story suitable for a validated tweak card.
decision.promotion_reopen_criteria: Reopen only if the app gains a verified rollback/snapshot contract and dedicated validation proof for the exact action.
